verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is documented as a terminal agent that runs locally against your repository and toolchain. The evidence shows local headless `exec` runs, a local `--sandbox workspace-write` policy, and an /agents session command center, but nothing about delegating tasks to an isolated cloud execution environment. Local sandboxing and local session management are adjacent features, not cloud background execution, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment
